title: Operion
tagline: Event-driven workflows for every company on your platform, in one binary on PostgreSQL.

features.title: Catalog events
features.text: Register your Kafka events once and let each tenant build workflows on them, from webhooks and schedules too.

features.title: Your own nodes
features.text: Add node types as HTTP services in any language, with signed calls and answers that can come days later.

features.title: One binary, one database
features.text: Run a single container next to PostgreSQL, with waits and retries that survive restarts.
